app.title: Absor Connect
app.welcomeDescription: Connect to S3-compatible storage or SSH servers, organize your connections, and drag & drop files between your computer and your remote servers.

settings.title: Settings
settings.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
settings.installBlockedBySession: Installation is deferred because a remote session is active or the agent status has not been verified. Check that the device can be updated without interrupting access, then try again.
settings.errorCodeSign: The automatic update could not be applied because the app is not code-signed. Please download the new version manually from GitHub.
settings.themeHint: Switch between light and dark mode
settings.importError: Import error: the file does not have a valid format.
settings.exportWarning: The exported file contains your credentials (access keys, passwords and passphrases) unencrypted. Keep it in a safe place. When importing, current connections will be replaced.

sidebar.title: Connections
sidebar.noConnectionsHint: Click + to add an S3 or SSH connection.

local.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
local.confirmDeleteMultiple: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} items?

s3.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
s3.confirmDeleteMultiple: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} items?

sftp.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? Folders are deleted with all their contents.
sftp.confirmDeleteMultiple: Are you sure you want to delete {{count}} items? Folders are deleted with all their contents.
sftp.failedToConnect: Could not connect to the server

errors.SSH_AUTH_FAILED: Authentication failed: the server rejected the username, password or key.
errors.SSH_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the server. Check the host and port.
errors.SSH_TIMEOUT: The server did not respond in time.
errors.SSH_CONNECTION_LOST: The connection to the server was lost.
errors.SSH_KEY_UNREADABLE: Could not read the private key ({{detail}}).
errors.SSH_KEY_PASSPHRASE: The private key needs a passphrase, or the passphrase is incorrect.
errors.SFTP_NOT_FOUND: The file or folder no longer exists on the server.

terminal.connectionLost: The connection to the server was lost.

store.credentialsUnavailable: The saved credentials for this connection cannot be read. Edit it and enter them again.
store.unreadableCredentials: The credentials of {{count}} connection(s) are not available: they could not be read on the computer they were uploaded from, or the service cannot decrypt them. They are kept: edit those connections to enter them again.
store.corruptRecovered: The connections file was damaged and could not be read. A copy was kept at: {{path}}
store.reenterCredentials: The saved credentials cannot be read. Enter them again, or leave them empty to keep the saved ones.
store.encryptionUnavailable: This system has no secure storage available (for example, Linux without a keyring): your account session is stored unencrypted on this computer.

auth.subtitle: Sign in to have your connections on all your computers.
auth.expired: Your session has expired or was closed elsewhere. Please sign in again.

errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.email_taken: An account with that email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.connections_conflict: Another computer saved changes in the meantime.
errors.connections_invalid: The service rejected the connection list.
errors.network_error: Cannot reach the service. Check your internet connection.
errors.server_error: The service is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

unreachable.title: Cannot reach the service
unreachable.description: Absor Connect keeps your connections in your account. Check your internet connection and try again.

migration.title: Connections on this computer
migration.description_one: There is 1 connection saved on this computer by a previous version. Do you want to upload it to your account? It will then be removed from this computer.
migration.description_other: There are {{count}} connections saved on this computer by a previous version. Do you want to upload them to your account? They will then be removed from this computer.
migration.failed: The migration could not be completed: {{reason}} Your connections are still on this computer and you will be asked again the next time you sign in.
migration.done: Connections uploaded to your account and removed from this computer.

cloud.conflict: Another computer changed your connections. The current list has been loaded and your last change was not saved: please repeat it.
cloud.saveFailed: The change could not be saved: {{reason}}

account.title: Account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your sessions on other computers have been closed.
account.deleteWarning: Your account and all your saved connections will be deleted, on all your computers. This cannot be undone.

devices.title: Devices
devices.hint: The PCs in your account running Absor Connect. To control one, it must be online with remote control turned on; you will be asked for its password.
devices.empty: There are no devices in the account yet.

state.busy: Busy: another device is controlling it
state.unsupported: Its system doesn't allow remote control

errors.generic: Could not load the device list.
errors.remote_unavailable: Remote control is not available on the service right now.

agent.revokeTitle: Revoke unattended access for this device
agent.revokeDetail: Its connections will end within 30 seconds. A new agent enrollment will be required to enable access again. S3 and SSH connections are preserved.
agent.declared: Capabilities declared by the agent; certification pending.

readiness.legacy_session: User mode: requires the app and an open system session. Quitting the app stops the host.
readiness.not_certified: Unattended access is not yet certified for travel.
readiness.unknown: The mode of this device could not be verified.
readiness.offline: Offline: check this device and an alternative access method before travelling.

background.title: Background
background.keepHint: Closing the window keeps the app running in the system tray (the menu bar on macOS).
background.loginHint: The app starts by itself when you log in, without opening its window: only in the tray.

remoteAccess.title: Remote control of this PC
remoteAccess.wayland: Your Linux session uses Wayland, which doesn't let apps capture the screen or drive the mouse and keyboard. To control this PC, log in to an X11 session (you choose it on the login screen).
remoteAccess.enable: Allow this PC to be controlled
remoteAccess.enableHint: The other devices in your account will be able to see and use this PC with its password.
remoteAccess.active: Someone is controlling this PC right now.
remoteAccess.suggestBackground: If the app isn't running, this PC can't be controlled. Also turn on "Keep running in the background" and "Open at login" so it stays available even if you close the window or restart.
remoteAccess.firewall: Windows may ask whether Absor Connect can use the network: choose Allow, at least on private networks, or this PC can't be reached from the local network.
remoteAccess.name: PC name
remoteAccess.nameHint: How it appears in your account’s device list.
remoteAccess.passwordSet: Set. It is kept only on this PC and never sent to the service.
remoteAccess.passwordUnset: Not set: required to turn on remote control.
remoteAccess.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Changing it ends open sessions.
remoteAccess.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
remoteAccess.noEncryption: This system has no secure storage: what is derived from the password is stored unencrypted on this PC.
remoteAccess.confirmLocal: Ask for confirmation on this PC
remoteAccess.confirmLocalHint: After the right password, whoever is at the PC must accept the connection. If nobody answers in 30 seconds, it is declined.
remoteAccess.preventSleepHint: While remote control is on. The screen can still turn off.
remoteAccess.permissionsHint: Without these permissions the PC shows as "missing permissions" and refuses connections. After updating the app, macOS may revoke them: remove the app from the list and add it again.
remoteAccess.limits_win32: The lock or sign-in screen, User Account Control (UAC) prompts and programs running as administrator.
remoteAccess.limits_darwin: The lock or login screen. Since macOS 15, the system asks to confirm the screen recording permission every month, and someone has to accept it at the Mac.
remoteAccess.limits_linux: The lock or login screen. It only works in an X11 session, and sound needs PulseAudio or PipeWire with pactl.

logTypes.locked: Locked for 15 minutes after failed attempts

errors.password_too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
errors.unsupported: This system doesn't allow controlling the PC.
errors.not_signed_in: Sign in to your account to turn it on.
errors.device_name_invalid: The name must be between 1 and 100 characters.
errors.device_agent_owned: The API has assigned this device to an agent. User-host settings are disabled to preserve its identity and prevent a second session. You can revoke access from Devices. This does not verify service health or readiness.

remoteAccess.agentOwned: The API has assigned this device to an agent. User-host settings are disabled to preserve its identity and prevent a second session. You can revoke access from Devices. This does not verify service health or readiness.
remoteAccess.agentPersistenceFailed: The local disabled setting could not be saved. The user host is stopped for this run; check alternative access before quitting or restarting the app.
remoteAccess.localAgentManaged: This PC is reserved for the native service. User-host settings are disabled to prevent another session or identity.

localAgentState.absent: No active native installation was detected.
localAgentState.responding: The service responds. This configuration is not yet certified for unattended access.
localAgentState.unverified: The service could not be verified. Check its installation; quitting the interface does not stop it.

stop.requireEnrollment: This stop ends the session and requires a new authorized enrollment to reactivate the host. Quitting the interface does not stop it.
stop.unavailable: The local stop component is not installed or cannot be verified.
stop.confirmed: The service saved and confirmed the stop. A new authorized enrollment is required.

errors.forbidden: This window cannot request a stop.
errors.local_agent_unverified: The service state changed; no stop was sent.
errors.local_agent_busy: A local request is already in progress.
errors.local_agent_control_unavailable: The local stop component cannot be verified.
errors.local_agent_stop_unconfirmed: The stop could not be confirmed. Do not assume the host has stopped; local review is required.

viewerAgent.waiting: Waiting for a new frame from the current context. The previous image is hidden.
viewerAgent.missing: The host has no current image. The previous image is hidden.
viewerAgent.protectedHint: Protected context: clipboard, files and sound are suspended.
viewerAgent.reconnectHint: Files, clipboard and sound remain suspended until you reconnect.
viewerAgent.inputUnavailable: The host does not support input in this context. Clipboard, files and sound are suspended.

viewerOperations.title: Manage PC

details.lock: The PC session will be locked.
details.logout: Save work on the PC before signing out. You will need to authenticate again.
details.restart: Save work on the PC. A normal restart will be requested; applications may prevent it.
details.secure_attention: Windows will open its security screen if supported by the agent.

viewerOperations.unavailable: The action is no longer available on this connection.
viewerOperations.connection_lost: The connection ended without confirming the result.
viewerOperations.timed_out: No confirmation arrived. The command will not be resent; reconnect before another action.
viewerOperations.failed: The PC could not perform the action.
viewerOperations.waiting: Restart requested. Waiting for the PC to become available…
viewerOperations.waitHint: Up to five minutes. Availability alone does not confirm that the system has finished restarting.
viewerOperations.ready: The PC reports that it is available again.
viewerOperations.expired: The PC did not report availability within five minutes.
viewerOperations.authenticateAgain: Authenticate again with the PC password to connect.

travel.title: Travel preparation
travel.notCertified: This device does not yet have a certified unattended access configuration.
travel.certifiedNone: Certified capabilities: none. Being online or declaring a feature does not prove access to the lock or sign-in screen.

exit.user_session: User mode needs an open OS session and Absor Connect running. Quitting the app stops the host; opening it at login does not provide access before sign-in.
exit.interface_only: Quitting this interface does not send a stop command to the native service. This does not guarantee availability after locking, signing out or restarting.
exit.unverified: This device is reserved for the agent, but the service cannot be verified. The user host is not automatically reactivated; do not assume access after quitting the app.

state.idle: The service responds with no active remote session.
state.active: The service reports an active remote session; this does not prove support for protected screens.
state.validation_required: The service requires fresh account authorization.
state.revoked: Service authorization has been revoked; a new authorized enrollment is required.
state.unknown: The service state could not be verified.

travel.recovery: Before travelling, test the contexts you need from another network and prepare alternate access. Boot encryption may require physical intervention after a restart.
travel.declaredYes: declared by the agent, not certified

agentSetup.title: Unattended access
agentSetup.notCertified: The native service is still being validated. This configuration is not certified for travel without alternate access.

phase.unavailable: An agent installer is not yet available for this PC.
phase.idle: User mode. You can prepare migration when a compatible component is available.
phase.preparing: Preparing migration. The user host is reserved.
phase.prepared: Migration prepared; activation still needs confirmation.
phase.committed: Migration confirmed. Also check the agent’s actual status and permissions.
phase.compensating: Removal is awaiting local and account confirmation.
phase.intervention_required: Intervention required: another host will not be enabled automatically.

agentSetup.packageUnavailable: Lab prototypes are not installed from this screen. Final installers for each OS remain pending.
agentSetup.cancelled: Operation cancelled. The previous state is preserved.
agentSetup.error: The operation could not be confirmed. Check the status and recover or remove the migration; do not enroll a second device.
agentSetup.signIn: Sign in to the owner account.
agentSetup.password: Create this PC’s password in user mode first.
agentSetup.encryption: An available secure store is required to import the password.
agentSetup.confirmChoice: Explicitly choose confirmation for each connection
agentSetup.confirmRequired: Ask for confirmation at the PC (someone must be there).
agentSetup.confirmUnattended: Allow connections without local confirmation, after verifying the account and PC password.
agentSetup.adminPermission: The OS will request administrator permission when a compatible installer is available. Preparation preserves identity, password, options and lockout; it does not activate the worker yet.
agentSetup.policyIntervention: The imported options require features this component does not support yet. They are preserved and the worker is not activated.
agentSetup.recoveryHint: Recovery requires the protected component and the account session that started enrollment. A lost reply does not authorize regenerating the identity or password.
agentSetup.passwordChange: To change the PC password, retire the agent first, change the password in user mode and enroll again. Signing out or revoking also requires a new enrollment.
